evidence.detail: The static initializer accepts a String key, R143 LoadoutFolder and R143 LoadoutPersistence, and immediately returns without seeding unless the target LoadoutFolder is empty.

When empty, it constructs a large built-in catalogue of LoadoutDefinition presets with explicit names such as 'Melee' and 'Hybrid (NH)', exact equipment-slot item ids, inventory LoadoutItemEntry quantities, spellbooks and skill/config values.

Every constructed record is expressed exclusively through the already-reviewed LoadoutDefinition, LoadoutEquipmentSlot, LoadoutItemEntry and LoadoutSpellbook model graph and inserted into the supplied LoadoutFolder.
The method receives the reviewed LoadoutPersistence object alongside the folder/key, tying the seeded defaults directly to the persisted Loadouts subsystem rather than a generic item preset table.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the built-in default loadout catalogue initializer; no original stripped identifier is claimed.
